info.name: MoreTables API
info.description: Full v1 API. Variables: baseUrl; token (guest or staff Bearer); challenge_token (guest OTP flow / staff 2FA); admin_challenge_token + admin_token (admin flow). Mailgun: mailgun_api_key, mailgun_domain, mailgun_endpoint for folder 00. IDs are placeholders. Public and authenticated endpoints may return HTTP 429 when rate limits are exceeded; retry with backoff. Reservation availability is live. Reservation writes enforce recurring hours and date-specific special-day overrides, returning HTTP 422 when a requested time is outside effective booking hours or availability changes during processing.

variable.description: Guest: from auth/start. Staff: from auth/staff/login.
Mailgun private API key (Basic: user api, password = key)
Discovery section slug, e.g. top-booked, top-viewed, top-saved, highly-rated, new-on-moretables, featured

item.name: Front of House Backend Integration
item.description: Staff OTP resend, authenticated Reverb authorization, service periods, table availability, removed reservations, dining stages, waitlist cancellation, and shift-note contracts.

request.description: Returns effective service periods with default_turn_time_minutes and party-size turn_times used by front-of-house seated-duration alerts.

Returns individually fitting tables in data, reusable saved combinations in available_combinations, and capacity-agnostic physical tables in combination_candidates for temporary combinations. Conflicting combination members are omitted.
Returns live table state. A seated reservation takes precedence over upcoming bookings on the same table, and current_reservation.service_stage drives the floor table colour and icon.

Pre-shift Report (shift notes) is Premium-only — 403 'Upgrade to Premium to access the Pre-shift Report.' below that. Listing and deleting notes stay available on any plan (see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md).
Same Premium-only plan requirement as creating a note — see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md.
Lists the restaurant's servers. Servers are restaurant records, not user accounts.
Adds a restaurant server using only a name. This does not create or invite a user.

item.name: 00 - Mailgun (direct API)
item.description: Send a test message through Mailgun to confirm DNS and keys before relying on app OTP email (Guest Start). Does not hit MoreTables API.

urlencoded.value: If you receive this, Mailgun outbound works.

request.description: POST /v3/{domain}/messages. Use same domain as MAILGUN_DOMAIN in Laravel.
GuestStartRequest: email required. Response includes challenge_token — copy to collection variable challenge_token.
VerifyChallengeRequest: challenge_token (uuid), code (4 digits), device_name optional (max 100). Copy token from response to variable token.
ResendChallengeRequest: challenge_token (uuid) from auth/start.
SocialLoginRequest: id_token required. Optional: device_name, first_name, last_name.
SocialLoginRequest: same as Google — id_token required; optional device_name, first_name, last_name.
StaffLoginRequest: identifier (email or username string) + password. Returns challenge_token.
VerifyChallengeRequest: challenge_token from staff login, code (4 digits), device_name optional.
Change the authenticated merchant staff user's password. Requires correct current_password and merchant staff role.
ForgotPasswordRequest: email required.
ResetPasswordRequest: token (from email), email, password + password_confirmation (Laravel Password defaults).
GuestCompleteProfileRequest: first_name and last_name are required. phone is optional and must be unique when supplied. Bearer token from verify-otp.
Marks the authenticated account as pending deletion, cancels active verification challenges, and revokes all access tokens. The user record is retained.
Start restoring a pending-deletion account. Sends an email OTP and returns a challenge_token. No auth required.
Verify the restore OTP, reactivate the account, and return a new Bearer token.
Resend the account restore verification code for an active restore challenge.
Fetch the authenticated user's profile settings for the web settings screen.
Update the authenticated user's profile settings. Supports first_name, last_name, bio, and birthday.

item.name: List restaurants
item.description: Public restaurant listing. Only active restaurants with an active or trialing merchant subscription (current billing period not expired) are returned. Response includes hours summarized from preferred meal schedules (earliest opens_at to latest closes_at per day, falling back to legacy hours).

request.description: Typeahead search suggestions grouped by locations, restaurants, and cuisines. Only publicly listed restaurants (active with active or trialing merchant subscription) appear in restaurant and location results.

item.name: Show restaurant
item.description: Public restaurant detail response including hours summarized from preferred meal schedules (earliest opens_at to latest closes_at per day, falling back to legacy hours), meal_types / meal_schedules for business hours, rewards_enabled, reservation_reward_points, active reward_rules, summary, and discovery_metrics with reviews_count, average_rating, ratings_breakdown (counts keyed 5–1), and category_breakdown (food, service, ambience, value averages). Returns 404 when the restaurant is inactive or does not have an active or trialing merchant subscription.

query.description: Optional earliest slot time (H:i). When provided, returns slots starting at or after this time on the requested date.

request.description: Live reservation availability. Optional time filters slots to those starting at or after the given H:i value on the requested date. Returns 404 when the restaurant is inactive or does not have an active or trialing merchant subscription.

Homepage discovery rails for mobile and web. Only active restaurants with an active or trialing merchant subscription appear, and the highly rated rail excludes restaurants without reviews. Each restaurant includes reservation_times for the requested date and party size when tables are available.

Paginated view for a single discovery section. Only publicly listed restaurants appear, and the highly rated section excludes restaurants without reviews. Each restaurant includes reservation_times for the requested date and party size when tables are available.
Public list of cuisine options for restaurant onboarding and filters.

Public reviews from publicly listed restaurants (active with active or trialing merchant subscription), ordered by highest rating first, with rating, nullable notes, customer name, and restaurant name. Within the same rating, order is random.

Tracks restaurant detail views used for Top Viewed discovery ranking. Repeated views from the same user, session ID, or IP within 30 minutes return HTTP 200 with deduplicated=true and do not create another row. This endpoint may return HTTP 429.
Public review feed with pagination links, summary (reviews_count, average_rating, ratings_breakdown, category_breakdown for food/service/ambience/value), and presentation-ready reviewer details.

Public list of published Moretable Lineup blog posts. Pass latitude & longitude to show experiences near the diner, ordered nearest first; each item then includes distance_km. radius_km defaults to 25.
Public detail of a published Moretable Lineup blog post by slug.
Current lifetime loyalty points, current tier, next tier, and tier thresholds.

Paginated reward point ledger: earn (credit) with restaurant/reservation source and expires_at; redeem (debit) with credit_value/credit_currency and consumed lots; expire (debit) when points pass their 1-year validity.

Redeem a configured tier of lifetime points for restaurant credit. Points must match an active redemption tier (see GET me/rewards/status). Returns the debit transaction with credit value and FIFO consumption details.

request.description: Set use_points to true to deduct the customer's entire available points balance when the reservation is created. The response records the amount in reservation.redeemed_points; a 422 is returned when the customer has no available points. accept_points separately controls whether the customer earns points after completing the reservation. Availability is checked live inside a restaurant-scoped lock. The guest and restaurant organization owner are notified by email and WhatsApp when phone details and WhatsApp credentials/templates are configured. Nigerian local phone formats such as 08012345678 are normalized to Meta's 2348012345678 format. Retry HTTP 422 validation responses when availability changes during processing.

Capture a card BEFORE booking a slot covered by a card-hold cancellation policy. Charges a nominal verification amount to save the card (auto-refunded once verified) and returns authorization_url/access_code plus a reference. Pass that reference as card_hold_reference when creating the reservation. The card is only charged the policy hold amount if the guest is a no-show. Returns 422 when the slot does not require a card hold.

Cancel the customer reservation. The guest and restaurant organization owner are notified by email and WhatsApp when phone details and WhatsApp credentials/templates are configured. Nigerian local phone formats such as 08012345678 are normalized to Meta's 2348012345678 format.
OpenTable-style "Notify me" alerts. Returns the authenticated guest's active table-availability alerts.

Watch a restaurant for a table matching party size, date, and time window. When a table opens the guest is notified via push, email, and (when whatsapp_updates is true and the guest has SMS/WhatsApp alerts enabled) WhatsApp. Returns HTTP 201 for a new alert, or HTTP 200 with the existing alert if an identical active alert already exists.
Add additional guests to the reservation.
Returns the fixed 'post_dining' template always. The 'blank' (build-your-own) template is only included for restaurants on the Premium plan — see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md.

Foundation/Core restaurants get 403 'Upgrade to Premium to customize your survey questions.' if template_key isn't 'post_dining' or questions differ from the fixed template — see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md.

Foundation/Core restaurants get 403 'Upgrade to Premium to customize your survey questions.' if a 'questions' field is sent that differs from the fixed post_dining template. Other fields (title, description, channels, send_delay_minutes) stay editable on any plan — see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md.
Defense-in-depth: also re-checks the Premium-only question-customization rule at publish time — see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md.

Requires the restaurant to be on the Core or Premium plan (403) 'Upgrade to Core or Premium to configure your reservation widget.' below that. Read-only 'Widget settings show' above stays available on any plan, and the public embed keeps working on already-published widgets regardless of plan (see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md).

Sends an in-app + push notification broadcast to the restaurant's guests. audience is 'all' (every user with an active or completed reservation) or 'selected' (only users linked to the provided guest_contact_ids, which come from the merchant guests endpoint). No WhatsApp or email is sent. Automated Email Campaigns (this whole endpoint) is Premium-only — a Foundation/Core restaurant gets 403 'Upgrade to Premium to send automated email campaigns to guests.' (see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md).

Both automated_messaging.enabled and reservation_messaging.enabled report as false for a restaurant below Premium, even if previously enabled (e.g. before a downgrade) — reflects effective state without altering stored data. See docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md.

Setting enabled=true requires the restaurant to be on the Premium plan — 403 'Upgrade to Premium to send automated email campaigns to guests.' below that. Setting enabled=false is always allowed. See docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md.
Same Premium-only rule as the automated-messaging toggle above — see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md.
Use Body > form-data: file + fields per API
Copies this media item's file into a new media row tagged with the given gallery_category_id — used to add an already-uploaded photo to another category without re-uploading it.

Create a menu item. Send JSON (raw) or multipart form-data when attaching images. Optional media fields: featured_image (file), featured_image_alt_text, gallery_images[] (files), gallery_image_alt_texts[], gallery_category_ids[].

formdata.description: Optional featured image (jpg, jpeg, png, webp; max 10MB)
Optional alt text for featured image

request.description: Use form-data for file upload

Availability is checked live inside a restaurant-scoped lock. For overnight service, starts_at uses the actual calendar date and timezone offset. The previous day service window and shift rules remain applicable after midnight; closed special days and reservation duration limits still apply. guest_contact.phone is optional. The guest and restaurant organization owner are notified by email and WhatsApp when phone details and WhatsApp credentials/templates are configured. Nigerian local phone formats such as 08012345678 are normalized to Meta's 2348012345678 format. Retry HTTP 422 validation responses when availability changes during processing.
Reservation responses expose arrived_at, seated_at, completed_at, and finished_at lifecycle timestamps when those transitions have occurred. finished_at is the UI-facing alias of completed_at.

Assign exactly one selection shape: restaurant_table_id, table_combination_id, or restaurant_table_ids (at least two for a temporary combination). Every member is rechecked inside the restaurant reservation lock.
Marks the reservation arrived and sets arrived_at on the first arrival transition. Later changes between partially arrived and arrived preserve that original timestamp.
Marks the reservation partially arrived and sets arrived_at only when no arrival time has previously been recorded.
Marks the reservation seated and occupies every assigned table. Optionally accepts exactly one table selection shape; omitting one seats at the existing assignment.
Marks the reservation completed and records completed_at. Responses also expose the same value as finished_at for front-of-house clients.
Marks every physical table assigned to a completed reservation available in one transaction.

Cancel the reservation as restaurant staff. The guest and restaurant organization owner are notified by email and WhatsApp when phone details and WhatsApp credentials/templates are configured. Nigerian local phone formats such as 08012345678 are normalized to Meta's 2348012345678 format.
Merchant aggregate reviews summary with overall rating, total reviews, rating distribution, and category averages for food, service, ambience, and value.
Merchant detailed reviews table with diner, review date, rating, category ratings, and commentary. Supports rating, search, date range, sorting, and pagination query parameters.
Assigns a single table, saved combination, or temporary combination and immediately converts the waitlist entry into a seated reservation.
Stores a single table, saved combination snapshot, or temporary combination while keeping the party in its current waitlist status. It does not seat the party.

item.name: Special Days
item.description: Special days override recurring availability for one restaurant date. Closed special days expose no booking slots. Open special days require at least one non-overlapping shift. Reservation writes enforce these overrides and return HTTP 422 for invalid times.

item.name: Weekly Shifts
item.description: Weekly recurring shifts define booking windows, turn times, table availability, turn controls, and flow settings for each day of the week. Shifts are seeded once from onboarding business hours when a restaurant has no shifts yet.

request.description: Show the restaurant booking policy, including booking details locale, custom dining policy text shown to diners, and the default 1-hour modification/cancellation cutoff.
Update booking details locale and custom dining policy text. `custom_dining_policy` must be 100-1000 characters when provided.
List cancellation and no-show policies for the restaurant.

Create a cancellation or no-show policy. `management_method` is currently `card_hold`. `party_size_scope` can be `all_party_sizes`, `large_parties_only`, or `custom` (requires `min_party_size` and `max_party_size`). `days` are 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Reservation Holds (this whole resource) is Core/Premium-only — 403 'Upgrade to Core or Premium to set up reservation holds.' below that (see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md).
Show a single cancellation or no-show policy.
Update a cancellation or no-show policy. Same Core/Premium plan requirement as creating one — see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md.
Delete a cancellation or no-show policy. Deletion is allowed on any plan, unlike create/update — see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md.

Check whether the restaurant offers MoreTables credits (rewards_enabled AND a Core/Premium plan — see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md) and whether it has entered its own custom reward score (reservation_reward_points differs from the default).
List the restaurant's custom reward-point rules.

Create a custom reward-point rule. Omit or empty `times` to award the points all day on the selected days. `days` are 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Requires the restaurant to be on the Core or Premium plan — a Foundation restaurant gets 403 'Upgrade to Core or Premium to set up the Guest Loyalty Program.' (see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md).
Show a single reward-point rule.
Update a reward-point rule. Same Core/Premium plan requirement as creating one — see docs/PLAN_PERMISSIONS.md.
Delete a reward-point rule.
